reminderTemplates.title: Electricity bill
tips: Have your SC number and customer ID ready
Pay on eSewa, Khalti, connectIPS, or at the NEA counter
2% off if paid within 7 days of the meter reading
Penalty from day 16: 5%, then 10% after day 30, 25% after day 40

reminderTemplates.title: Water bill
tips: Have your KUKL customer number ready
Pay on eSewa, Khalti, the KUKL app, or at the counter
KUKL gives a rebate for paying early
Old arrears must be cleared before online payment is accepted

reminderTemplates.title: Internet bill
tips: Have your customer ID or username ready
Pay in the provider's app, eSewa, Khalti, or at the counter

reminderTemplates.title: Telephone bill
tips: NTC landlines run on an advance deposit; top it up before it runs out
Check the balance: dial 1606, or SMS CB*<number> to 1415
Pay on eSewa, Khalti, or with an NTC recharge card

reminderTemplates.title: Rent payment
tips: Keep a receipt for every payment
The landlord owes 10% house rent tax; the agreement should say who pays it

reminderTemplates.title: Loan EMI
tips: Have your loan account number ready
Late instalments draw penal interest after a short grace period
Overdue past 90 days, the loan is classed non-performing

reminderTemplates.title: School fee
tips: Have the student ID ready
Keep the payment receipt

reminderTemplates.title: Medicine refill
tips: Take the prescription
Note the medicine name and dose

reminderTemplates.title: Subscription
tips: Rename this to the service: Netflix, YouTube Premium, iCloud, gym…
Add one reminder per subscription
Cards are charged automatically; cancel before the date to stop it

passport.fee: From Rs 5,000 (34 pages); verify current revenue
passport.location: Department of Passports, Tripureshwor, or your DAO
checklist: Marriage or migration certificate (if details changed)
passport.note: Adults get 10 years, under-18s 5. Renewal opens once less than a year is left, and many visas need six months of validity.

drivingLicence.location: Apply on EDLVRS, then the Transport Management Office for biometrics
drivingLicence.note: Valid 10 years (5 from age 60). Renewing late adds a fine, and a licence expired more than 5 years is cancelled.

bluebook.fee: Provincial tax by CC/kW + renewal fee
bluebook.location: Transport Management Office, Nagarik App, or provincial portal
bluebook.note: Due by Ashad end each fiscal year. Late fine on the tax: 5% within 30 days, 10% for the next 45, 20% after that, then 32% per year.

insurance.note: A lapsed vehicle policy blocks bluebook renewal. Life policies usually allow a grace period of about 30 days (15 for monthly premiums).

warranty.note: Check for faults before it ends — repairs after that are paid.
